          Business Ownership     
          Drives towards the achievement of maximum sales and growth in line with company vision and values.     
          Participates in all aspects of merchandise and communications with merchant and vendor partners     
          Reviews business trends in partnership with functional leads to create and execute business strategies.     
          Builds and maintains positive relationships with the vendor community, abiding to Bergdorf Goodman’s business goals as guiding principles. Positively challenges vendor community’s status quo as needed.     
          Provides input on strategic objectives for the store and sets priorities accordingly by department         
     
          People     
          Partners in the training of sales associates and assistants.     
          Participates in Associate performance management, career development, and coaching as needed.     
          Recognizes and celebrates outstanding Associate performance, addresses opportunities for business and behavioral evolvement with courage, empathy and positivity.     
          Manages team's daily prioritization of tasks.     
          Manages the goals set for the team in alignment with department objectives and supports Associates in achieving them.     
          Manages scheduling of department Associates with sensitivity to promotional calendar and business needs.     
          Champions own self-development, communicating needs to fulfill expectations and always manifesting an attitude of learning.

          Executes the plans and strategies in partnership with Client Development

          2-3 years of relevant experience, luxury jewelry retail experience required

          "Win together" mentality

          Continuously builds skills and knowledge through training, coaching, and career experiences     
          Demonstrates a working knowledge and appreciation of the NMG business and the fashion industry     
          Conveys energy and enthusiasm for BG and personal work     
          Adapts personal approach in response to diverse situations and people     
          Responds to unexpected changes in work environment with creativity and resilience     
          Establishes and upholds high personal standards for individual work and environment     
          Maintains a customer-centric mentality versus a solely store-centric one

     We offer an inclusive and comprehensive range of benefits to our valued associates, including:
   
      Medical, Dental, Vision Benefits   
      Disability Benefits   
      Paid Parental Leave, Paid Family Leave, and Adoption Support   
      Paid Time Off

     As one of the largest multi-brand luxury retailers in the U.S., with 3,000+ of the world's most desirable brand partners, we're delivering exceptional products and intelligent services enabled by our investments in data and technology. description_text:
Bring Your Amazing Self to Work 
  At Macy's, Inc. we're on a mission to create a brighter future with bold representation for all. This is our Mission Every One. We know that each person here is unique. So we respect and invest in each individual to create growth, pride, and satisfaction. If we are able to bring our whole selves to work, it translates into a more abundant and wider array of ideas and energy for all to benefit from. Our success will be built on amazing colleagues, working together.  
  
  Job Overview 
  The Associate, Designer exudes dynamic and passionate creativity while proficiently researching understanding categories, trends, and customer preferences. Collaborating closely with people leaders and senior design professionals, they actively contribute to cohesive product presentations, strategically decide on styles, materials, and colors, and employ Adobe and CLO programs for design development. The role extends beyond technical skills, placing emphasis on cross-functional alignment, active participation in meetings, and responsiveness to customer feedback. As an emerging leader, the Associate, Designer inspires a one-team mindset, encourages creative thinking, and navigates change with resilience and optimism, thereby making impactful contributions to Macy's design community.  
  
  What You Will Do 
  
  Develop robust skills in researching categories, trends, and customer preferences, with the ability to effectively communicate findings. 
  Create original designs as a motivated and passionate designer. 
  Collaborate with people leaders to produce cohesive product presentations, including boards, tear sheets, CADS, and samples to sell the collection to counterparts. 
  Work closely with the Senior Designer/Design Director on the development and execution of product designs that align with overall product strategy and merchandise objectives. 
  Select and approve styles, materials, trims, and colors that fit into the program and style plans, with support from people leaders. 
  Develop flat mechanical sketches for design development packages and provide feedback to assistant designers on sketches and development packages (where applicable). 
  Review and provide feedback on development samples in partnership with people leaders. 
  Take responsibility for approving strike-offs, samples, and other development materials. 
  Utilize Adobe and CLO programs for style, color, and pattern development. 
  Adhere to and contribute to prioritizing the seasonal time and action calendar for the area of responsibility. 
  Maintain industry knowledge, representing and supporting the Macy’s brand while building and maintaining relationships. 
  Actively participate in meetings with cross-functional partners. 
  Foster relationships and communicate regularly with cross-functional partners and vendors to gather input and expand knowledge. 
  Collaborate with the Tech team to ensure correct specifications are used for sample development and attend all fit sessions with Technical Design and Design Teams. 
  Review customer feedback and adjust designs based on reviews. 
  Grow assistant designers (where applicable), lead peers, manage up, and gain influence across the organization. 
  Inspire, motivate, and engage with a one-team mindset. 
  Engage the team by evaluating current practices and encouraging creative thinking about how things could be more effective and efficient. 
  Participate in and contribute ideas in a clear, confident, and composed manner. 
  Take risks and celebrate risk-taking regardless of the outcome. 
  Possess a collaborative, consultative style with a strong ability to establish trust and build relationships across all levels and functions of the organization. 
  Demonstrate resilience, tenacity, and high energy, with the ability to rapidly bounce back from adversity. 
  Embrace change with realistic optimism and persist through challenges and setbacks caused by change.   
  
  Skills You Will Need 
  
  Research and Communication Skills: Develop robust skills in researching categories, trends, and customer preferences, demonstrating an ability to effectively communicate findings to various stakeholders. 
  Creative Design: Create original designs with motivation and passion, showcasing a strong creative vision and the ability to bring innovative ideas to fruition. 
  Collaboration and Presentation: Collaborate effectively with people leaders to produce cohesive product presentations, utilizing boards, tear sheets, CADS, and samples to compellingly sell the collection to counterparts. 
  Product Development and Decision-Making: Work closely with the Senior Designer/Design Director on the development and execution of product designs, ensuring alignment with overall product strategy and merchandise objectives. Demonstrate the capability to select and approve styles, materials, trims, and colors that align with program and style plans. 
  Technical Proficiency and Adaptability: Utilize Adobe and CLO programs for style, color, and pattern development, showcasing technical proficiency. Additionally, adhere to and contribute to prioritizing the seasonal time and action calendar for the area of responsibility, demonstrating adaptability and organizational skills.   
  
  Who You Are 
  
  Dedicated to fulfilling ideals of diversity, inclusion, and respect that Macy’s aspires to achieve every day in every way. 
  Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3-5 years of industry experience. 
  Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision. 
  Strong color sense/print sense. Ability to view and differentiate the color spectrum. 
  Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, CLO, and PLM. 
  Ability to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.   
  
  What We Can Offer You 
  
  An inclusive, challenging, and refreshingly fun work environment 
  Competitive pay and benefits rooted in principles of equity 
  Performance incentives and annual merit reviews 
  Merchandise discounts 
  Health and Wellness Benefits across medical, dental, vision, and additional insurance 
  Retirement Savings Plan with 401k match opportunity 
  Employee Assistance Program (mental health counseling and legal/financial advice) 
  Resources for continuous learning, career growth, and leadership development 
  8 paid holidays 
  Paid Time Off (first year prorated depending on start date) 
  Tuition reimbursement program 
  Guild education benefit funds 100% of tuition, books, and fees in designated programs 
  Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) and give-back/volunteer opportunities 
  Empowerment and autonomy to perform impactful work with tangible results   
  
  About Macy’s 
  Now is an exciting time for a Macy's career as we continue to focus on creating exciting and memorable experiences for every Macy's customer, whether their journey starts online or in the store. Our opportunities in Sales, Merchandise, Operations, Customer Service, Warehouse, Marketing, and other areas let you express your creativity and commitment to excellence, grow your career and make a difference to your Macy's colleagues and customers.  
  
  Bring your creativity, energy, and ideas to the Macy's team – Apply Today!  
  
  MERCH00  This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

  Create original designs as a motivated and passionate designer.

  Take responsibility for approving strike-offs, samples, and other development materials. 
  Utilize Adobe and CLO programs for style, color, and pattern development.

  Actively participate in meetings with cross-functional partners.

  Engage the team by evaluating current practices and encouraging creative thinking about how things could be more effective and efficient.

  Take risks and celebrate risk-taking regardless of the outcome. 
  Possess a collaborative, consultative style with a strong ability to establish trust and build relationships across all levels and functions of the organization.

  Embrace change with realistic optimism and persist through challenges and setbacks caused by change.

Demonstrate the capability to select and approve styles, materials, trims, and colors that align with program and style plans.

  Dedicated to fulfilling ideals of diversity, inclusion, and respect that Macy’s aspires to achieve every day in every way.

  Strong color sense/print sense. Ability to view and differentiate the color spectrum. 
  Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, CLO, and PLM. 
  Ability to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.   
  
  What We Can Offer You 
  
  An inclusive, challenging, and refreshingly fun work environment 
  Competitive pay and benefits rooted in principles of equity 
  Performance incentives and annual merit reviews 
  Merchandise discounts 
  Health and Wellness Benefits across medical, dental, vision, and additional insurance 
  Retirement Savings Plan with 401k match opportunity 
  Employee Assistance Program (mental health counseling and legal/financial advice) 
  Resources for continuous learning, career growth, and leadership development 
  8 paid holidays 
  Paid Time Off (first year prorated depending on start date) 
  Tuition reimbursement program 
  Guild education benefit funds 100% of tuition, books, and fees in designated programs 
  Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) and give-back/volunteer opportunities 
  Empowerment and autonomy to perform impactful work with tangible results

  Now is an exciting time for a Macy's career as we continue to focus on creating exciting and memorable experiences for every Macy's customer, whether their journey starts online or in the store. Our opportunities in Sales, Merchandise, Operations, Customer Service, Warehouse, Marketing, and other areas let you express your creativity and commitment to excellence, grow your career and make a difference to your Macy's colleagues and customers.

description_text:
The Designer at Lands’ End is responsible for designing and developing our accessories by interpreting concepts into finished product. This includes developing themes, color, fabrication, and silhouettes for the upcoming season as well as working with mills to develop original textures and patterns. Other responsibilities include the development of presentation boards and presenting lines in concept meetings. They would also conduct raw material research, market research, flat sketches and fashion illustration, detailed specs, and fabric/trim research and allocations. This person would be responsible for developing and coaching associate and assistant designers as well as building and developing relationships with cross functional and cross divisional partners. They would collaborate with Merchandising and Sourcing to achieve production execution. This person will also be responsible for following the Lands’ End design direction; adapting their design ideas into product that serves the Lands’ End customer and drives the Lands’ End brand. 
  Successful candidates will have the following knowledge, skills and abilities: 
  
  5-7 years of related experience in and a degree in design. 
  A thorough understanding of textile construction, color and printing techniques. 
  Ability to do flat drawings/sketches for design prototypes. 
  Able to interpret trends and translate them to our customer. 
  Strong organization skills and attention to detail. 
  Ability to multi-task, problem solve and work on multiple projects at one time. 
  Ability to meet deadlines and work in a team environment. 
  Strong interpersonal written and verbal communication skills. 
  Fluent in adobe suite and IPLM. 
  Travel is required. 
  
 The pay range for this position is $65,300 - $102,700. An employee’s pay within the salary range will be based on numerous factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, geographical location, and business or organizational needs. description_text:
About Us:
     Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.
      Graphic Design     What could be more exciting than putting your mark on some of the world’s most famous and well-loved fashion brands and licenses? As a Manager of Graphic Design for Centric Brands, you’ll use your skills and creativity to create designs based on style plans, sales needs and emerging trends. You will also ensure that your work can be transformed into a finished product in a timely manner and at an appropriate price point. This means working not only with our technical design and production teams, but also building collaborative relationships with outside vendors and other external stakeholders. The challenges are exciting and the possibilities endless – as you contribute your skills in a vibrant, customer- and people-centric culture that celebrates you as a valuable member of the team.
  Specific Responsibilities Would Include: 
    The Graphic Arts Manager drives the seasonal design implementation process, from concept to delivery, by supervising a team of graphic arts to create original, trend-appropriate art concepts that meet the product needs and drive sales, managing the timely execution of each stage in the process, and coordinating across categories to ensure consistent quality and look. Help expedite pitch projects and special projects for Licensed and Branded Product, from sizes Infant to Adult.
      ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES     Strategy & Innovation   Shop and perform research to isolate key, relevant trends for each category or brand, where appropriate; review and provide perspective on competitive analysis; Research and pull Internet reference to assist Graphic Team development.  Oversee development of initial seasonal design concepts in context of larger assortment and cost structure; collaborate with Design and Creative Director to devise style plans and design according to trends; ensure timely execution of product development calendar; coordinate among design teams to ensure brand cohesiveness, where appropriate, across categories     Operations & Results   Lead team in troubleshooting, including identifying and resolving quality and technical issues  Supervise creation of Illustrator sketches, Graphic Art concepts and all-over repeat development  Work cross-divisionally with Design, Final Art and Production Teams    
    Customers & Relationships   Direct interoffice communication and follow-up with internal and external customers and contacts, including suppliers and vendors; partner with production and tech; manage interoffice communication and relationships with vendors and internal customers  Partner with the Law Department to ensure that graphics/designs do not infringe on intellectual property rights and register new rights where necessary  Partner with IT to monitor and make recommendations for enhancements, upgrades and purchases     Leadership & Teams   Contribute positively to team dynamic and manage up where necessary  Attract, develop and retain talent  Monitor and evaluate performance of individuals and team  Work collaboratively and respectfully with Graphic, Design and Sales Team Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have: 
   Strong ability to lead a Team and work collaboratively with others, including Managing up in a professional environment   Experience with graphic, print and presentation development. A well rounded diverse experience a strong plus.   Superior organizational skills and excellent communication skills; team oriented   Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines; highly detail oriented, meticulous and creative   Creativity, technical capability and sensibility for merchandising; strong ability to sketch   Strong ability to give directions in a clear and concise manner   Bachelor’s Degree in Fashion Design.   8 - 10 years experience in apparel design; significant relevant experience in category   Highly proficient in Adobe programs, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop, Microsoft Outlook, Mac computers     In return, we provide an industry-competitive salary, along with a comprehensive benefits plan (medical, dental, vision) that includes a matching 401(k), Summer Fridays, generous PTO, merchandise discounts, excellent career development opportunities, and a work environment that reflects our industry leadership. Our social impact program, Centric Cares, focuses on volunteerism to make a difference in communities we live and work in and our D&I committee is shaping the future of diversity, equity and inclusion at Centric Brands though workshops, resources and inspiring conversation.
      Salary Range: $80,000-104,000
      At Centric Brands, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we seek to structure competitive compensation offers to ensure that we are able to attract and retain the best talent. Our job postings include an annual base salary range at the time of employment. The stated base salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on several factors, including the selected candidate's educational and professional experience, industry knowledge, location, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the selection process. Base salary is a part of a total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, annual bonus and other Centric Brands sponsored benefit programs.
      Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.      Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer      Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

Grounded in a belief that style, quality and value should all be found in one place, Express is a brand with a purpose - We Create Confidence. Customers can experience our brands in over 400 Express retail and Express Factory Outlet stores, 50 Bonobos Guideshops, and online at www.express.com and www.bonobos.com.   About Express   Grounded in a belief that style, quality and value should all be found in one place, Express is a brand with a purpose - We Create Confidence.     REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS     College degree or equivalent work experience   Minimum 4 years Technical Design within the apparel industry      CRITICAL SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES     Strong communication skills (written, verbal and interpersonal)   Consistently demonstrated strong leadership within live fit sessions & other cross-functional team meetings   Leverages a strong understanding of garment engineering, apparel factory operations & patternmaking to achieve business goals   Models agility/ability to multitask & adapt to change   Proven ability to independently, consistently & appropriately manage risk at all stages of product development   Proven ability to independently lead and influence through clear and consistent actions in a cross-functional team environment   Ability to manage & follow through on a task from start to finish within a specified timeline without supervision      Benefits and Compensation:     Express offers a range of benefits to help protect full-time associates health and long-term financial security including:
     Medical, pharmacy, dental and vision coverage   401(k) and Roth 401(k) with Company match   Merchandise discount   Paid Time Off   Parental leave for new moms and dads      Part-time associates may be eligible to receive paid sick leave, public health emergency leave and to participate in the 401(k) and Roth 401(k) with Company match. Additionally, part-time associates are eligible to receive a merchandise discount, and to choose voluntary benefits through YouDecide. Full-time associates may be eligible to participate in our incentive plan.

description_text:
Bring Your Amazing Self to Work 
  At Macy's, Inc. we're on a mission to create a brighter future with bold representation for all. This is our Mission Every One. We know that each person here is unique. So we respect and invest in each individual to create growth, pride, and satisfaction. If we are able to bring our whole selves to work, it translates into a more abundant and wider array of ideas and energy for all to benefit from. Our success will be built on amazing colleagues, working together.  
  
  Job Overview 
  The Senior Designer is a highly skilled designer and category expert who demonstrates strong leadership abilities.  
  
  What You Will Do 
  
  Collaborate with the Director of Design to conduct trend and category research, including analysis of the retail market relevant to the area of responsibility. 
  Partner with the Director of Design to establish the brand's seasonal fashion direction, ensuring consistent aesthetic integrity. 
  Research and interpret seasonal trends, fashion direction, and cultural influences, sourcing inspiration from various outlets such as runways, museums, and tradeshows. 
  Develop and execute a strategic vision that prioritizes customer needs while meeting sales and profit objectives, leveraging technical expertise to identify opportunities and develop assortments. 
  Take ownership of product design from concept to production, leading the design team in the development and execution of product designs. 
  Collaborate with the Director/Senior Director on fabric and material selection, understanding the rationale behind decisions. 
  Interpret specific color palettes, patterns, and prints for the season, selecting and approving styles, materials, trims, and colors. 
  Ensure designs align with overall product strategy and adhere to SKU plans and assortment strategies set by merchants. 
  Partner closely with the Materials team to create seasonal palettes and support fabric optimization. 
  Work with the Product Development team to ensure designs meet cost guidelines and collaborate with Strategic Sourcing for vendor allocation. 
  Lead fit sessions with Tech Design and Product Development teams throughout the season, ensuring clear communication and alignment on fit standards. 
  Create cohesive product presentations, including boards, tear sheets, and samples, to effectively communicate design concepts to merchants. 
  React to current product selling performance based on customer feedback and sales results, incorporating learnings into future designs. 
  Adhere to seasonal timelines and action calendars for the area of responsibility, ensuring timely execution of design tasks. 
  Demonstrate comfort and effectiveness in leading through complexity, combining visionary thinking with a focus on speed. 
  Maintain an industry presence to foster connections, explore new business opportunities, and represent the Macy’s brand. 
  Cultivate relationships with technical designers, merchants, and sourcing divisions to exchange ideas and streamline processes. 
  Serve as the primary contact with the Vendor Community (Overseas/Domestic) and communicate regularly with overseas offices to share line development direction. 
  Collaborate closely with Omni partners to gather input and align online development direction, influencing decision-making. 
  Anticipate potential obstacles and actively seek solutions while providing context and rationale for decision-making. 
  Practice open and clear communication, keeping stakeholders informed and making decisions confidently and succinctly. 
  Foster a collaborative environment, building trust and relationships across all levels of the organization to influence decision-making. 
  Develop engaged and high-performing teams, coaching and motivating design staff while identifying and nurturing talent. 
  Embrace risk-taking and encourage innovation, regardless of the outcome, while tracking and coaching team development and talent. 
  Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and implement solutions, mentoring others outside direct reports to foster their growth. 
  Demonstrate resilience, tenacity, and high energy, bouncing back rapidly from adversity.   
  
  Skills You Will Need 
  Design Expertise: Possess advanced design skills and expertise within the designated category, demonstrating proficiency in conceptualizing and executing product designs. 
  Leadership Abilities: Exhibit strong leadership skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with the Director of Design, lead design teams, and influence decision-making processes. Develop and motivate design teams, fostering engagement, and high performance while identifying and nurturing talent for future growth. 
  Trend Analysis: Ability to conduct thorough trend and category research, analyze retail market trends, and interpret seasonal fashion directions. 
  Creative Vision: Demonstrate a creative vision that aligns with the brand's seasonal fashion direction, ensuring consistent aesthetic integrity. 
  Strategic Thinking: Develop and execute strategic visions that prioritize customer needs while achieving sales and profit objectives, leveraging technical expertise to identify opportunities and develop assortments. 
  Color and Print Sense: Possess a strong sense of color and print, with the ability to interpret specific color palettes, patterns, and prints for each season. 
  Technical Skills: Proficiency in design software such as Illustrator, Photoshop, and PLM, as well as Microsoft Office and Excel for communication and organization. 
  Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively convey design concepts, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and maintain clear and open communication channels. 
  Adaptability and Resilience: Demonstrate adaptability and resilience in navigating complexity, bouncing back rapidly from adversity, and proactively identifying opportunities for process improvement.  
  
  Who You Are 
  
  Dedicated to fulfilling ideals of diversity, inclusion, and respect that Macy’s aspires to achieve every day in every way. 
  Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 5-7 years of industry experience. 
  Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision. 
  Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.   
  
  What We Can Offer You 
  
  An inclusive, challenging, and refreshingly fun work environment 
  Competitive pay and benefits rooted in principles of equity 
  Performance incentives and annual merit review 
  Merchandise discounts 
  Health and Wellness Benefits across medical, dental, vision, and additional insurance 
  Retirement Savings Plan with 401k match opportunity 
  Employee Assistance Program (mental health counseling and legal/financial advice) 
  Resources for continuous learning, career growth, and leadership development 
  8 paid holidays 
  Paid Time Off (first year prorated depending on start date) 
  Tuition reimbursement program 
  Guild education benefit funds 100% of tuition, books, and fees in designated programs 
  Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) and give-back/volunteer opportunities 
  Empowerment and autonomy to perform impactful work with tangible results   
  
  About Macy’s 
  Now is an exciting time for a Macy's career as we continue to focus on creating exciting and memorable experiences for every Macy's customer, whether their journey starts online or in the store. Our opportunities in Sales, Merchandise, Operations, Customer Service, Warehouse, Marketing, and other areas let you express your creativity and commitment to excellence, grow your career and make a difference to your Macy's colleagues and customers.  
  
  Bring your creativity, energy, and ideas to the Macy's team – Apply Today!  
  
  MERCH00   This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

Overview: 
    About PHOENIX    PHOENIX Retail, LLC is a Direct-to-Consumer platform operating EXPRESS and BONOBOS in the United States. Grounded in a belief that style, quality and value should all be found in one place, Express is a brand with a purpose - We Create Confidence. We Inspire Self-Expression. - powered by a styling community. Bonobos is a menswear brand known for being pioneers of exceptional fit and a personalized, innovative retail model. Customers can experience our brands in over 400 Express retail and Express Factory Outlet stores, 50 Bonobos Guideshops, and online at www.express.com and www.bonobos.com.   About Express   Grounded in a belief that style, quality and value should all be found in one place, Express is a brand with a purpose - We Create Confidence. We Inspire Self-Expression. - powered by a styling community. Launched in 1980, Express has been a part of some of the most important and culture-defining fashion trends. The Express Edit design philosophy ensures that the brand is always ‘of the now’ so people can get dressed for every day and any occasion knowing that Express can help them look the way they want to look and feel the way they want to feel. Location Name: New York Office Responsibilities: 
    The Lead Technical Designer manages a team of individual contributors and one or more product categories. These product categories and centers of excellence are defined and focused in the product pillar of the Expressway Forward strategy. They also lead vendor calibration and support the VP with special projects. A Lead Technical Designer demonstrates master-level product development, risk mitigation, time management, planning, organization, fitting, coaching, influencing skills as well as strong people leader skills.
      KEY RESPONSIBILITIES     Oversees and manages a defined strategic product category(s) aligned to the Long Range Plan (LRP) and ExpressWay Forward strategy.   Model Brand Values & Express Core Competencies – Accountable, Collaborative, Courageous, Results Driven.   Uphold & refresh department engineering standards, processes & tools.   Conduct research & development to drive innovation, block updates & achieve department goals.   Train new vendor & factory technical partners.   Calibrate & certify strategic global partners to function as a member of the Express TD team.   Establish & approve garment specifications from concept through to production approval. Evaluate & mitigate risk at each stage. Influence product design & engineering to meet fit, function, price & delivery goals. Determine when each product is ready for production.   Ensure vendors receive only production viable prototype requests.   Oversee sample tracking & fit planning.   Lead fit sessions, guide merchants & designers and drive alignment to finalize action plans.   Utilize Accumark, Creative Cloud, Yuniue & 3D to expedite accurate product results & train others to utilize these systems.   Ensure Express owned Tech packs (including labeling, marketing, and packing requirements) are compliant with all established business & department standards.      REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS     College degree or equivalent work experience   5+ years experience in Technical Design   Managed multiple product categories (knits, wovens, tops, bottoms, etc)   Proficient in Yunique or similar PLM system; Adobe Illustrator Creative Cloud; Accumark 10.3; Outlook; Excel; Word   Preferred System Proficiency: 3D (CLO or Browzwear); Photoshop      CRITICAL SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES     Proven ability to lead and influence through clear concise communication and consistent actions in a cross-functional team environment   Successfully trained and mentored/managed others   Successfully functioned as a role model for adapting to change, driving results, executional excellence, taking initiative, resolving conflict   Has leveraged many different resources to completing and meeting deadlines      Benefits and Compensation:     Express offers a range of benefits to help protect full-time associates health and long-term financial security including:
     Medical, pharmacy, dental and vision coverage   401(k) and Roth 401(k) with Company match   Merchandise discount   Paid Time Off   Parental leave for new moms and dads     Part-time associates may be eligible to receive paid sick leave, public health emergency leave and to participate in the 401(k) and Roth 401(k) with Company match. Additionally, part-time associates are eligible to receive a merchandise discount, and to choose voluntary benefits through YouDecide. Full-time associates may be eligible to participate in our incentive plan.
      Actual compensation offered is dependent upon a number of factors including, but not limited to, work location, education, relevant skills and experience of the candidate.  Salary Range: $110,300 - $167,200 Closing:

description_text:
Backend
                                The Awareness & Acquisition studio works to make sure Spotify is top of mind when users are looking for audio and to inspire our most loyal customers to tell their friends about Spotify. While we are best known for owning and building the Wrapped consumer-facing experience each year, we also work extensively in the SEO domain and experiment with various new features collectively known as Delightful Moments.
             Location             New York
               Job type        Permanent
                 
           Spotify is looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Moonlight team within Awareness & Acquisition. Our mission is to create in-app experiences that give strategic audiences more reasons to talk about Spotify with their friends, family, and other fans. We strive to fulfill this mission by building 0-to-1 features according to 3 strategic pillars: audio identity, time-sensitive moments, and fandom. 
          
       We’ve been collaborating with PZN for the past year to launch and expand Daylist, which is now available in over 70 markets and streamed by millions of users daily. This year, we look forward to rolling out a new Voting feature that lets users participate in televised award shows by voting for their favorite artists directly in the Spotify app.
           
          If you are interested in being a part of a multidisciplinary team building new and exciting user experiences, apply today!
             What You'll Do        Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists to build end-to-end features for millions of users     Architect, develop, and operate Java services following good design and development practices     Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle for backend services - from inception and design, through deployment, operation and optimizationParticipate in evolving the team’s technical strategy and product roadmap     Drive forward technical initiatives, starting within your team and scaling them across Spotify     Work on what you want during regular hack days and annual hack weeks             Who You Are        You have an intermediate to advanced understanding of object-oriented programming concepts and architecture patterns     You have proven experience designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components. Familiarity with providers like AWS or GCP is a plus     You enjoy working collaboratively on a full-stack team, using agile processes to deliver a project in incremental phases     You solve problems methodically and can investigate issues in complex systems     You care about quality, delivering high-quality products and supporting others to maintain a high standard.     You enjoy learning as well as teaching others. You are passionate about your work, pursuing the goals of the team and, ultimately, the Spotify mission - "giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the opportunity to enjoy and be inspired by it"             Where You'll Be        We are a distributed workforce enabling our band members to find a work mode that is best for them!     Where in the world? For this role, it can be anywhere in the North America region in which we have a work location     Prefer to work in an office environment? Prefer to work from home instead? Not a problem! We have plenty of options for your working preferences. Find more information about our Work From Anywhere options here.     Working hours? We operate within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.             Our global benefits            Extensive learning opportunities, through our dedicated team, GreenHouse.
               Flexible share incentives letting you choose how you share in our success.
               Global parental leave, six months off - fully paid - for all new parents.
               All The Feels, our employee assistance program and self-care hub.
               Flexible public holidays, swap days off according to your values and beliefs.
             Learn about life at Spotify            The United States base range for this position is $122,716- $175,308 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team   Tax Senior (Hybrid) Full time, Atlanta, Georgia, United States   The Tax Senior contributes to the preparation of federal, state, local, and special tax returns by collecting, analyzing, and formatting financial information. This role prepares/reviews quarterly and annual income tax provisions following IAS 12. This position also researches tax issues as needed, resulting in thoughtful documentation. In this role, you will manage the tax staff.   As a Tax Senior, you will  
     Prepare the annual and quarterly tax provisions in Excel and One Source Tax provisions.   Review all U.S. federal and state income tax, including international forms (such as forms 5472 and 8865)   Review the preparation of a U.S. federal and state income tax partnership return.   Review outside tax firm's preparation of Canadian Tax returns and gathering of data for an outside provider.   Oversee and monitor of property tax filings   Review U.S. Federal and state estimated tax payments   Supervise and review the work of a Tax Senior   Work with the Senior Tax Director and SVP of Tax and Treasury to develop tax strategies and improve the tax position and tax efficiencies on both a federal and state level.   Assist with responding to federal, state, and local tax notices and managing federal, state, and local tax audits and examinations as needed.   Have the ability to learn international tax and transfer pricing adjustments for a global company, as well as indirect tax (Sales, VAT, withholding, etc).   Advise on the proper structure of legal entities and intercompany activity while overseeing compliance with transfer pricing.   Monitor and analyze proposed and newly enacted tax legislation, regulations, rulings, court cases, etc., determining the impact of exposure.   Miscellaneous tax questions and withholding forms for a Global Company    About you  
     Bachelor's degree in Accounting; CPA and/or MST   3-4 years of relevant tax experience in public accounting or industry   Significant practical experience in U.S. tax, U.S. international tax, and U.S. tax Reform matters.   Ability to identify, research, and propose resolutions on tax issues   Must possess strong organizational and leadership skills, including ability to prioritize   Detailed-oriented, with proven ability to drive projects to fruition   Strong analytical skills and ability to problem-solve   Excellent interpersonal and communication skills   Management of external providers   Experience with One Source Tax provision is strongly preferred   Experience with SAP or other GL systems is preferred   Ability and willingness to develop    About us   We’re a market leader in travel management: We help people and companies travel smart and achieve more, and our clients include some of the world’s best-known and most innovative business and consumer brands. We operate in more than 100 countries, and the majority of our 10,000+ people work virtually (because a 10-second commute usually makes awesome sense). We’re committed to sustainability and to driving success for our customers, our business and ourselves. Learn more about BCD Travel.   Your life at BCD   Working at BCD means connecting, collaborating and celebrating. You’ll be part of a virtual, dynamic and flexible work environment that fosters a good work-life balance so you can focus on what makes you happy. But don’t just take our word for it! Hear why people join BCD and more about the great perks of Life at BCD.   You’ll be offered     Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities   Opportunities to grow your skillset and career   Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge   A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools   Travel industry professional perks and discounts   Work From Anywhere program: you have the potential to work remotely in another country for up to 60 days per year!   An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated    At BCD Travel we value you, our culture and success is defined by you. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Tax Manager is between $90,000 and $110,000. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience and geographical location.   Ready to join the journey? Apply now! We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other positions.  #LI-Hybrid  #LI-LR1

Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver.  Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable.   Position Summary   Maintains the Provider Data (demographic and contractual) for all network and non-network providers.  Ensures all provider information is accurately recorded and maintained to provide for proper reimbursement and member access (i.e., directory listings).  Develops and maintains standards for database integrity, corrective actions, database alignment, and manages communication processes with other departments regarding database improvements.  Provides support for baseline provider data transactions that cannot be administered automatically through the provider database due to system limitations and/or data   integrity issues.   Performs baseline demographic transaction updates in provider system applications in support of claim adjudication and Provider directory.  Performs intake triage and responds to network inquiries, escalates when necessary.  Provides on-going department support in research and analysis essential to resolving concerns/issues raised by providers and other internal/external customers.  Conducts audits of provider information and escalates issues for resolution as appropriate.  Automates and manually loads, maintains, and resolves all new and revised participating provider data transactions (basic to complex).  May also load third party contracted reimbursement into applicable systems.    Required Qualifications   1-3 years' of Provider Data Services background.  1-3 years' Network background.  Demonstrated ability to handle multiple assignments.    Preferred Qualifications   1+ years' QNXT experience.  Microsoft Excel skills  Production driven role experience   Strong written and verbal communication skills.    Education   High school diploma or GED    Pay Range  The typical pay range for this role is:  $18.50 - $31.72

In addition to your compensation, enjoy the rewards of an organization that puts our heart into caring for our colleagues and our communities. At UnitedHealthcare, we’re simplifying the health care experience, creating healthier communities and removing barriers to quality care. The work you do here impacts the lives of millions of people for the better. Come build the health care system of tomorrow, making it more responsive, affordable and equitable. Ready to make a difference? Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.  
   We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced individual to join our team as a DSNP (Dual Special Needs Plan) Coordinator for Kansas Medicaid. This role will be responsible for assisting with the operational integration between Medicare and Medicaid programs, as well as serving as the primary point of contact for providers encountering issues with the DSNP program. The DSNP Coordinator will play a crucial role in ensuring effective coordination and collaboration between various stakeholders, including Medicare and Medicaid agencies, healthcare providers, and internal teams.   You’ll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.   Primary Responsibilities: 
  
  Act as a subject matter expert on DSNP program requirements, policies, and procedures for Kansas Medicaid 
  Collaborate with Medicare and Medicaid agencies to ensure seamless operational integration between the two programs 
  Serve as the primary point of contact for healthcare providers encountering issues or challenges related to DSNP 
  Investigate and resolve provider concerns, complaints, and escalations related to DSNP, ensuring prompt and satisfactory resolutions 
  Develop and maintain solid working relationships with healthcare providers, fostering open communication and trust 
  Provide guidance and training to healthcare providers on DSNP program requirements, billing processes, and documentation standards 
  Stay current on changes to Medicare and Medicaid regulations, policies, and guidelines. Communicate relevant updates to internal teams and providers 
  Analyze data and metrics related to KS DSNP program performance, identifying areas for improvement and proposing solutions 
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements and enhance the overall efficiency and effectiveness of DSNP operations 
  Participate in meetings, workgroups, and committees related to DSNP program management and quality improvement initiatives 
  Prepare senior leadership reports and presentations on DSNP program performance, challenges, and recommendations    You’ll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.  Required Qualifications: 
  
  2+ years of experience in the healthcare industry 
  1 + years of experience working with Medicare and Medicaid programs

BPM – where caring and community is in our company DNA; we are always striving to be our best selves; and we’re compelled to ask the questions that lead to innovation.
     
        Working with BPM means using your experiences, broadening your skills, and reaching your full potential in work and life—while also making a positive difference for your clients, colleagues, and communities. Our shared entrepreneurial spirit drives us to see and do things differently. Our passion for people makes BPM a place where everyone feels welcome, valued, and part of something bigger. Because People Matter. BPM is looking for a meticulous and self-motivated individual to oversee the scheduling and assignment planning for Tax professionals. This person will also serve as a key contact with the Tax leaders and employees to successfully address issues relating to staff scheduling/assignments.
     
        What you get:        Total rewards package: from flexible work arrangements to personalized benefit structures and financial compensation options that give you choice and flexibility    Well-being resources: interactive wellness platform and incentives, an employee assistance program and mental health resources, and Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) that…    Balance & flexibility: 14 Firm Holidays including 2 floating, Flex PTO, paid family leave, winter break, summer hours, and remote work options, so you can balance challenging yourself with taking care of yourself    Professional development opportunities: A learning culture with CPA exam resources and bonuses, tuition reimbursement, a coach program, and live classes, workshops, and seminars through BPM University     
        Who is successful at BPM:        · Caring people who put others first
        Self-starters who embody the BPM entrepreneurial spirit    Authentic individuals with a diverse point of view    Lifelong learners with a drive to excel    Resilient people who rise to the occasion    
      You Have: (Qualifications)             B.A. degree OR equivalent work experience.      +3 years in a professional services role, heavy administrative support and/or HR experience OR at least 2-3 years in a Resource management role.      Familiarity with public accounting is a plus.      Excellent customer service, interpersonal, facilitation, project management, and change management skills.      Ability to adapt to different challenges, and listen/respond to others.      Ability to interact with all levels of employees from entry level to executives.      Strong computer skills – Outlook, Excel, Word; Ability and desire to master resourcing software, and Time & Billing software. Power BI knowledge is a plus.           
      You Will: (Requirements)             Drive greater efficiency in resource deployment by providing business stakeholders with visibility/options of resource capacity, capabilities and conflict resolution.      Advocate for sharing resources firmwide, including offshore team, to move towards the “BPM One” culture.      Coordinate frequent resource management meetings with leaders and Operations Director and specialists to address resource needs, conflicts and any other issues.      Continuously build strong relationships with managers and staff in order to drive resourcing initiatives.      Oversee internal team members’ workload and performance.      Analyze trends and make recommendations to firm leadership on appropriate course of action to improve key metrics.      Maintain knowledge of the Resource Management field and stay up to date with current trends and new software developments.      Balancing the needs of staff and clients for the purpose of maximizing utilization and the experience of the staff.      Develop relationships with personnel in the firm to understand career goals, development needs, and to assign staffing resources to engagements based on their preferred specialty area(s).      Work on developing/maintaining staff matrix.      Review staff utilization/headcount report and discuss plans to address efficiency with the practice.      Review resourcing forecast reports and address requirements, proposed solutions and ensure chargeable hours are in line with previous year.      Interact with HR staff firm-wide to coordinate new hire schedules, training schedules, and other HR related activity including performance evaluations.           
      $105,000 - $130,000
        The salary range provided is intended for candidates in the San Francisco Bay Area who meet the minimum requirements of the position. Candidates who do not reside in the San Francisco Bay Area, do not meet the minimum requirements, or exceed the requirements are encouraged to apply and a recruiter will provide you with a range specific to your location and qualifications.

description_text:
Sr Manager - Factory Supply Chain - Remote                                            At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.
             
       
             At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
             
       
             Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.
             
                   POSITION SUMMARY:       
             The Corporate Factory Supply Chain Sr. Manager is responsible for the co-development, alignment, and supporting the execution of the supply chain strategy across a network of factories. The position serves as a functional lead, single point of contact and escalation role for Supply Chain within the factory. This role is accountable for Factory Supply Chain Strategy, development of Supply Chain Leaders, achieving supply chain results within each site, and overall health of the Supply Chain function at each site. The role also supports the Business Manufacturing Strategy as part of the category cross-functional teams.
             
       
             KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:       
             Develop, align, cascade, and execute the Supply Chain strategy across a network factories. 
                 Co-develop Supply Chain strategy that is aligned to deliver T&P, Supply Chain, and business objectives 
         Ensure clear alignment of strategic priorities across Ensuring Supply and the Businesses 
         Partner with site Supply Chain Supervisors/Managers to generate performance glide paths and routines to support the achievement of factory and divisional objectives                Responsible for being the functional lead, single point of contact and escalation role for Supply Chain on the T&P Leadership Teams 
                 Represent Supply Chain as the functional leader for T&P leadership escalations 
         Provide direction on supply chain-related issues and opportunities 
         Ensure critical issues are escalated to the appropriate people/functions in order to develop solutions to resolve and achieve category objectives 
               Deliver results that ensure supply at the lowest total cost through E2E collaboration w/functional partners. 
                 Partner with functions to identify and deliver key improvement projects/initiatives 
         Establish and maintain proper governance with key functions to ensure alignment on driving E2E results and achievement of KPIs (COF, eMSA, NFG DOH, Inventory Accuracy, Raw/Pack Stock Cover, etc.) 
         Create environment for optimal performance through regular routines and consistent connections 
               Build capabilities of the Supply Chain teams by working collaboratively with Factory Supply Chain Supervisors and site Supply Chain leadership. 
                 Provide on-going support to increase supply chain competency at the sites to an expert level (focus on process mastership) 
         Create a culture of continuous learning and drive accountability at each site to establish formal learning plans for critical roles 
         Partner with FSC and T&P leadership to update and maintain individual Competency Matrix for critical Supply Chain roles, including Development Guides 
               Coach and develop Supply Chain Supervisors/Managers at the factory sites. 
                 Establish regular routines with each of the Supply Chain Managers within their Categories to focus on development and to provide on-going coaching 
         Promote adherence to the Critical Job Expectations for the Factory Supply Chain Supervisor/Manager role 
               Develop talent pipeline and succession planning for key Supply Chain roles through partnership with Supply Chain Managers. 
                 Identify high potential talent for focused development and training opportunities 
         Identify/develop training opportunities for high potential talent          Co-develop robust succession plans for critical supply chain roles (Factory and Corporate) 
               Identify Opportunities for Process Optimization and New Tools/Technologies. 
                 Collaborate with site Supply Chain leadership and other Nestle OpCo’s to prioritize efforts to identify new tools, technologies and capabilities that support breakthrough advancements 
         Create a forum to support sharing of new ideas and best practices 
                           Drive compliance to key Standards and Policies. 
                 Ensure adherence to critical Standards and Policies          Collaborate with site Supply Chain leadership to develop routines that support building an “audit ready” mindset 
         Provide Supply Chain support, along with FSC SCE, for all formal audits (NIA, ISO, EY, etc.) 
                                 REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:             
       
             Undergraduate degree or 5+ years’ experience in similar capacity 
       Understanding of manufacturing resource planning and material requirements planning 
       Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain and/or Manufacturing, preferably acting as Factory Supply Chain Manager or Manufacturing Excellence Manager. 
       Strong E2E knowledge of Supply Chain including production planning, materials scheduling, warehouse operations and inventory management. 
       Demonstrated ability to overcome obstacles in executing complex, multifunctional prioritized projects. 
       Experience leading cross-functional teams to drive performance improvement and change management initiatives.        Self-Motivator who can work towards resolution of problems. Strong and creative problem-solving skills. Effectively able to influence without authority.        Advanced skill level in MS Office, including Excel, Access and Word. 
       Experience with SAP and BW desired.        Experience with Advanced Planning Systems desired (e.g., SAP-APO, OMP) 
       Availability for travel (up to 25%) and work beyond the regular scheduled hours.             
       
                   The approximate pay range for this position is $140,000- $150,000 base salary. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location. Nestle offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefits packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at:About Us | Nestlé Careers (nestlejobs.com)

    As an Associate Underwriter within our Individual Life and New Business team, you will get the opportunity to support marketing goals by issuing life insurance coverage on a favorable and timely basis consistent with mortality/morbidity objectives. Support profitability goals by assessing the expected mortality/morbidity of individual life applicants, analyzing medical, non-medical, and financial information and classifying risk appropriately. If acting within a brokerage agency underwriting capacity, may need to negotiate offers for placement of policies with the appropriate carrier. This may include acting as a partner to sales managers and producers to arrive at the best solution for a proposed insured.
   
     Evaluate applicants consistent with the company's risk appraisal standards. Analyze lower face amount cases with fairly simple medical, non-medical, and financial underwriting issues. Utilize sound underwriting judgment which enhances the producer's ability to place a case, promote product competitiveness, and achieve mortality/morbidity objectives. Develop creative approaches which lead to placing business with the company.   Support the sales process by working in partnership with producers, field office staff, and field officers during the presale, underwriting, and policy issue and delivery processes. Establish effective working relationships. Proactively anticipate, address, and communicate case issues. Understand the producer's role and appreciate the submission of the business. Negotiate satisfactory outcomes for customers, producers, and the company that are fair to parties involved and utilize sound risk selection principles. Seek assistance, as appropriate, with more challenging cases.   Promote underwriting expertise to producers, field managers, and home office staff. Educate field managers and producers about the underwriting process.   Perform administrative functions as appropriate in expediting case processing and ensure compliance with complex, changing federal and state regulations and legislation. Provide clear file documentation and instructions for accurate issuance of policies.   Perform other job-related duties and special projects as required.   If working with variable products, must become an associated person of Principal Securities, Inc., which requires fingerprinting, and a full background check.      This position is also a phenomenal way to advance your career. As a growing company with over 18,000 employees around the world, Principal offers a lot of ways for you to learn more, earn more and achieve more.
  Who You Are: 
   College degree or 5+ years of related work experience.   Strong oral and written communications, negotiations, problem solving, team building, empathy, interpersonal skills, and decision-making abilities.   Strong time management, prioritization, and execution skills.   Basic understanding of insurance and contract law, and federal and state regulation and legislation a plus.   Ability to learn to analyze financial statements.   Understanding of new business function, life products, reinsurance, and personal/business marketing concepts.   Ability to work in a rapidly changing environment.   Ability to build effective working relationships with producers and field office staff.   If working with variable products, must become an associated person of Principal Securities, Inc.  Salary Range Information: Salary ranges below reflect targeted base salaries. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation for all roles will be based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Salary Range: $20.84 - $39.81 / hour Time Off Program: Personal Time Off (PTO) is provided to hourly (non-exempt) employees and provides a set amount of accrued time earned each pay period. Employees can use their PTO for vacation, personal or short-term illness. Pension Eligible: Yes Additional Information: 
    Work Environments      This role offers in-office, hybrid (blending at least three office days in a typical workweek), and remote work arrangements. If you're local to the Des Moines, IA or Charlotte, NC locations, we encourage coming into the office one day a week.
   Work Authorization/Sponsorship    At this time, we're not considering candidates that need any type of immigration sponsorship now or in the future or those needing work authorization for this role. (This includes, but is not limited to students on F1-OPT, F1-CPT, J-1, etc.)
   Nonimmigrant Workers and Green Card for Employment-Based Immigrants    Investment Code of Ethics     For Principal Global Investors positions, you’ll need to follow an Investment Code of Ethics related to personal and business conduct as well as personal trading activities for you and members of your household. These same requirements may also apply to other positions across the organization.
   Experience Principal    While our expertise spans the globe, we're bound by one common purpose: to foster a world where financial security is accessible to all. And our success depends on the unique experiences, backgrounds, and talents of our employees – individually and all of us together. Explore our core values, benefits and why we’re an exceptional place to grow your career!
   Principal is an Equal Opportunity Employer    All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
  Posting Window: We will accept applications for 3 full days following the Original Posting Date, after which the posting may remain open or be removed based upon applications received. If we choose to post the job again, we will accept additional applications for at least 1 full day following the Most Recently Posted Date. Please submit applications in a timely manner as there is no guarantee the posting will be available beyond the applicable deadline. Since our inception, our market leading cloud-native platform has offered unparalleled protection against the most sophisticated cyberattacks. We’re looking for people with limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to the customer to join us in shaping the future of cybersecurity. Consistently recognized as a top workplace, CrowdStrike is committed to cultivating an inclusive, remote-first culture that offers people the autonomy and flexibility to balance the needs of work and life while taking their career to the next level. Interested in working for a company that sets the standard and leads with integrity? Join us on a mission that matters - one team, one fight.
      About the Role:
     CrowdStrike is seeking a Deal Review Consultant to join our Worldwide Sales and Operations Organization and Global Renewals Management Function within the Customer Acquisition and Retention Excellence Organization. As a key sales and operations support function, the Deal Review Consultant is critical to CrowdStrike’s ability to achieve sustainable retention of key accounts, protect annual recurring revenue (ARR), and drive operational discipline in the field for customer retention and growth processes. This critical teammate will be responsible for: (i) building and scaling the deal review function (ii) driving execution through cross-functional partnerships across the organization.
      What You'll Do:
     Support the Field Sales Organization and Sales Operations team in driving ARR retention at scale through execution of the following:            Act as a business partner to the sales team in developing strategies for complex deals with a focus on financial and revenue compliance
             Provide sales leadership with financial modeling and evaluation of deal economics, commercial terms and conditions and operational requirements
             Actively communicate deal statuses and critical updates to sales management, ensuring transparency and timely information flow for strategic decision-making
             Make recommendations to sales leadership on deal approvals
             Responsible for reviewing deals and ensuring they are structured accurately and result in accurate booking and ARR metrics
             Advise on pricing strategies for new go-to-market offerings
             Play a key role in scaling the Deal Review function
             Propose and execute initiatives as part of the long term strategy for the deal review team
             Ensure that non-standard deals adhere to recognized revenue recognition principles
             Work cross functionally across various stakeholder groups including legal, sales operations, order management, revenue, finance and product management
             Function as point of contact and subject matter expert for sales on licensing and pricing models
             Drive adherence to internal processes and business rules
             Create and manage systematic CRM workflows alerting for non-standard orders
             Engage in testing and implementation of new CPQ applications, providing feedback and insights to optimize these tools for operational efficiency
         What You'll Need:
            6+ years of experience in enterprise sales and operations, finance and/or deal desk in high tech
             Experience with Annual Recurring Revenue business model
             Background in data analysis, modeling and/or financial analysis
             Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills
             Experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, and reporting as well as knowledge of data management and analytics solutions
             Knowledge of Enterprise Sales Infrastructure, such as Salesforce CRM/CPQ. Ability to understand complex systems and dependencies
             Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to quickly establish trust, credibility, and influence across a variety of partners
             Excels at working cross-functionally with Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT

     #LI-HK1
     #LI-Remote

            Remote-first culture
             Market leader in compensation and equity awards
             Competitive vacation and flexible working arrangements
             Comprehensive and inclusive health benefits

             A variety of professional development and mentorship opportunities
             Offices with stocked kitchens when you need to fuel innovation and collaboration
